difficulty_reason: The proof converts positivity of self-intersection to effective high powers via surface Riemann–Roch and Serre duality, excludes isotropic nontrivial classes by an integral perturbation, then replaces the ample reference class by an arbitrary positive-square class.
source_caveats: Smooth projective irreducible surface over the stated field. §20.2.16 uses standard surface Riemann–Roch as stated in Exercise 20.2.B(b), and §20.2.15 uses Serre duality.
